review_method: Independent read-only prospective exact-byte review with a final clean review after causal, chronology, identity, controlled-trace, and benchmark-authority corrections.

answers.basis: Two fixed families and eight configurations use completed five-minute inputs, deterministic 30-minute aggregation and ranks, one 11:30 New York decision, earliest 11:35 entry, and holds measured from actual entry.

Twenty context sessions and 377 discovery-only selection sessions precede nine mutually disjoint validation folds. Training P&L is prohibited, controlled ranges are fixed, and outcome-based adaptation is forbidden.
The long/flat portfolio has three fee-reserved one-third slots, one common scale, no leverage, no shorting, no resize or reentry, and a participation-matched SPY benchmark with separate cash proof.

The acquisition proposal separates exposed evaluation rows from context-only rows, leaves both controlled blocks unacquired, limits quotes to prospective cost calibration, and grants no network or result authority.
The fixed stages, immediate neighbors, gates, campaign succession, 232-specification ceiling, and 696-attempt ceiling reconcile without a hidden parameter search.

The candidate alone produces the create-only trace after its receipt. The authority pre-binds an immutable benchmark template; one transaction derives, verifies, registers, consumes its grant, and creates its receipt before trace or SPY access.
The implementation plan reuses existing boundaries where they fit, proposes only the missing generic cross-sectional components, and limits this phase to static and synthetic checks.
Every implementation, acquisition, strategy, qualification, controlled, holdout, PAPER, broker-write, and live authority remains false; no protected or runtime state was accessed.

resolved_before_final_verdict.finding: Core planning controls lacked structural assertions and the acquisition proposal did not bind exact plan bytes.
resolved_before_final_verdict.resolution: The focused test now asserts the frozen controls, and the acquisition proposal binds the exact plan SHA-256 and fingerprint.

resolved_before_final_verdict.finding: The first chronology reused selection evidence, the earliest fill was not causal, and controlled retries were ambiguous after a protected read.
resolved_before_final_verdict.resolution: Selection now ends before nine disjoint validation folds, entry begins at 11:35 with exits shifted from actual entry, and a protected-read receipt makes later failure terminal.

resolved_before_final_verdict.finding: The shared controlled selection trace had no receipt-bearing owner.
resolved_before_final_verdict.resolution: The candidate specification is the sole trace producer and create-only publisher; the benchmark may consume only the exact trace plus SPY fill bars.

resolved_before_final_verdict.finding: The benchmark specification could not be exactly authorized before the candidate trace identity existed.
resolved_before_final_verdict.resolution: The authority binds an immutable benchmark template whose only deferred field is the trace identity and fixes the canonical final-specification derivation.

resolved_before_final_verdict.finding: Summary prose conflicted with the atomic grant, registration, and receipt sequence.
resolved_before_final_verdict.resolution: Every normative occurrence now requires one transaction to derive, verify, register immutably, consume the grant, and create the receipt before a controlled benchmark read.

scope_limit: Read-only repository planning review. It did not use the network; access .trading-lab, market or quote records, returns, candidates, credentials, controlled blocks, PAPER, broker, live, or strategic-allocation-21 state; or run a strategy or backtest. Future provider entitlement, controlled calendars, and runtime atomicity remain fail-closed implementation obligations.
